name: siya
brief: Siya, clean-shaven young adult heroine of Siyaraj and daughter of a fireworks maker. Lean, graceful, expressive side-view game character based on the two user identity references: warm medium-brown skin, long black hair tied back with a loose curl, tiny bindi, simple gold jewelry, marigold-orange sari with crimson red-and-gold pallu, readable hands and feet, holding one unlit sparkler. The approved Basic Rakshas image is a style reference only. Same identity and pose: use a slightly more angular pallu edge with one broad, simple geometric gold border motif; keep all ornament large and sparse.
